Three cabins where the forest meets the fjord.

Wood stoves, cold water and long light. Two hours north of Bergen by car and ferry.

Built by a boat builder, run by his daughters.

Each cabin is framed in local pine and faces the water. No television, fast Wi-Fi, and a shelf of books left by the last guests.

Getting here

  1. 01

    Fly or train to Bergen. Direct trains from Oslo take about seven hours.

  2. 02

    Drive north on the E39. We send a map with the last, unmarked turn.

  3. 03

    Take the Halhjem ferry. Twenty minutes, every half hour, coffee on board.

Questions

Are pets welcome?+

Dogs are welcome in the Shore Cabin. Please keep them leashed near the sheep.

Is there food nearby?+

A small shop is ten minutes away. Breakfast baskets can be added to any booking.

When is the best season?+

June for endless light, September for colour and quiet, February for the northern lights.
